evidence.description: The month is updated before the report has been successfully decoded.

candidates.explanation: The method assigns latestMonth before performing the throwing serialization and decoding for latestReport. If either operation fails, the actor retains the new month alongside the previous report, leaving the two related properties inconsistent despite the method throwing an error.
candidates.title: Failed decoding leaves partially updated state

evidence.description: Keys are converted to dates, then reconstructed with yyyy-M rather than retaining the selected original key.

candidates.explanation: The original JSON key is discarded after parsing, and the selected date is formatted again to perform the lookup. Date parsing can accept representations that formatting does not reproduce exactly. For example, a zero-padded month key can parse successfully but be emitted without padding by the M pattern. The lookup then misses the existing report and substitutes an empty dictionary, causing decoding to fail.
candidates.title: Reformatted date may not match the original report key

evidence.description: The fixed-format parser specifies a date format and time zone but leaves locale and calendar implicit.

candidates.explanation: The formatter interprets machine-readable year/month keys without specifying a locale or calendar. Its defaults can depend on the user's settings, so the same key can be interpreted using a non-Gregorian calendar and produce a different absolute month. Setting UTC only fixes the time zone, not the calendar interpretation.
candidates.title: Machine-readable date parsing depends on user settings

evidence.description: The request discards the response and immediately parses the returned data as report JSON.

candidates.explanation: The response accompanying the downloaded data is discarded, so the method does not distinguish an unsuccessful HTTP response from a successful one before processing its body. HTTP error statuses do not inherently cause URLSession data requests to throw; an error body can therefore reach the parsing and state-update logic.
candidates.title: HTTP response status is ignored
